companies.name: Rockefeller Group Development Corporation
companies.quote: Ms. Brod is presently a Senior Vice President and Regional Development Officer, Northeast Region for Rockefeller Group Development Corporation, where she is responsible for overseeing the company’s current office, residential and mixed-use developments in the region, including projects in Manhattan, Flushing (Queens) and Hoboken, New Jersey.

companies.name: Bedrock Real Estate Partners
companies.quote: Prior to joining Rockefeller Group Development Corporation, Ms. Brod served as a principal at Bedrock Real Estate Partners, where she oversaw projects in New York City and Washington, D.C.

companies.name: Equity Residential
companies.quote: Ms. Brod has also worked for Equity Residential, where she started that company’s New York Development Group, growing its portfolio to more than $700,000,000 while leading projects in New York City (Manhattan and Brooklyn) and New Jersey (Jersey City and Montclair).
